# our schannel is ported to mbedTLS 3.6.7 and includes its headers directly;
# upstream dropped this line because they are still on 2.16.11 via the importlib.
include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/mbedtls/include ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/mbedtls/include/mbedtls)

add_definitions(-D_WINE)
spec2def(schannel.dll schannel.spec)

# schannel.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/schannel-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(schannel_shims OBJECT lsamode.c schannel_mbedtls.c schannel_main.c schannel_wine.c secur32_wine.c usermode.c stubs.c)
target_link_libraries(schannel_shims PRIVATE wine libmbedtls libcrypt32 libsecur32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(schannel_shims)
add_cargo_module(schannel schannel-cargo schannel.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS schannel_shims psdk)
